```{=html}
<script>
(function() {
  const questions = [
    "I notice if my voice changes with different emotions",
    "I notice how my voice changes when I speak in different situations",
    "I can tell I am angry by the sound of my voice",
    "I can tell if I am happy by the sound of my voice",
    "I can tell I am stressed/anxious by the sound of my voice",
    "I notice when my voice sounds husky",
    "I notice when my voice sounds rough",
    "I notice when my voice sounds breathy",
    "I notice when my voice sounds weak",
    "I notice when my voice feels strained",
    "I get worried if I feel pain/discomfort in my throat",
    "When my voice feels uncomfortable, it dominates my attention",
    "I get upset when I feel pain/discomfort in my throat",
    "I worry about my throat when it feels uncomfortable",
    "I notice my posture when I am talking",
    "I listen for clues from my voice to let me know what emotion I am feeling",
    "I notice changes in my breathing over the day",
    "I can continue to pay attention to my voice even when there is a lot happening around",
    "I can pay attention to my voice even when my mind is racing"
  ];

  let currentIdx = 0;
  const answers = new Array(questions.length).fill(null);
  let autoAdvanceTimer = null;

  function renderCard() {
    const total = questions.length;
    const qBody = document.getElementById('q-body');
    const submitBody = document.getElementById('submit-body');
    const btnBack = document.getElementById('btn-back');
    const btnNext = document.getElementById('btn-next');

    if (currentIdx === total) {
      document.getElementById('q-counter').innerText = 'Complete';
      document.getElementById('q-percent').innerText = '100%';
      document.getElementById('q-progress-fill').style.width = '100%';
      qBody.style.display = 'none';
      submitBody.style.display = 'block';
      btnBack.disabled = false;
      btnNext.style.display = 'none';
      return;
    }

    const pct = Math.round((currentIdx / total) * 100);
    document.getElementById('q-counter').innerText = 'Question ' + (currentIdx + 1) + ' of ' + total;
    document.getElementById('q-percent').innerText = pct + '%';
    document.getElementById('q-progress-fill').style.width = pct + '%';
    document.getElementById('q-text').innerText = questions[currentIdx];

    qBody.style.display = 'block';
    submitBody.style.display = 'none';

    const savedVal = answers[currentIdx];
    const optBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.ivs-opt-btn');
    optBtns.forEach(function(btn) {
      const val = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-val'), 10);
      if (val === savedVal) {
        btn.classList.add('selected');
      } else {
        btn.classList.remove('selected');
      }
    });

    btnBack.disabled = (currentIdx === 0);
    btnNext.style.display = 'inline-block';
    btnNext.disabled = (savedVal === null);
  }

  window.ivsSelect = function(val) {
    clearTimeout(autoAdvanceTimer);
    answers[currentIdx] = val;
    renderCard();

    if (currentIdx < questions.length) {
      autoAdvanceTimer = setTimeout(function() {
        currentIdx++;
        renderCard();
      }, 250);
    }
  };

  window.ivsBack = function() {
    clearTimeout(autoAdvanceTimer);
    if (currentIdx > 0) {
      currentIdx--;
      renderCard();
    }
  };

  window.ivsNext = function() {
    clearTimeout(autoAdvanceTimer);
    if (currentIdx < questions.length && answers[currentIdx] !== null) {
      currentIdx++;
      renderCard();
    }
  };

  window.ivsSubmit = function() {
    if (answers.includes(null)) {
      alert("Please answer all questions before submitting.");
      return;
    }

    const dataPayload = {};
    for (let i = 0; i < questions.length; i++) {
      dataPayload['q' + (i + 1)] = answers[i];
    }

    const ea = (dataPayload.q1 + dataPayload.q2 + dataPayload.q3 + dataPayload.q4 + dataPayload.q5) / 5;
    const pa = (dataPayload.q6 + dataPayload.q7 + dataPayload.q8 + dataPayload.q9 + dataPayload.q10) / 5;
    const vc = (dataPayload.q11 + dataPayload.q12 + dataPayload.q13 + dataPayload.q14) / 4;
    const va = (dataPayload.q15 + dataPayload.q16 + dataPayload.q17 + dataPayload.q18 + dataPayload.q19) / 5;

    dataPayload.ea = ea;
    dataPayload.pa = pa;
    dataPayload.vc = vc;
    dataPayload.va = va;

    document.getElementById('ivs-instructions').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('ivs-container').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('score-display').style.display = 'block';
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });

    document.getElementById('score-ea').innerText = ea.toFixed(2) + " out of 4";
    document.getElementById('score-pa').innerText = pa.toFixed(2) + " out of 4";
    document.getElementById('score-vc').innerText = vc.toFixed(2) + " out of 4";
    document.getElementById('score-va').innerText = va.toFixed(2) + " out of 4";

    setTimeout(function() {
      document.getElementById('bar-ea').style.width = (ea / 4 * 100) + "%";
      document.getElementById('bar-pa').style.width = (pa / 4 * 100) + "%";
      document.getElementById('bar-vc').style.width = (vc / 4 * 100) + "%";
      document.getElementById('bar-va').style.width = (va / 4 * 100) + "%";
    }, 50);

    const googleAppScriptURL = 'YOUR_GOOGLE_WEB_APP_URL_HERE';

    if (googleAppScriptURL && googleAppScriptURL !== 'YOUR_GOOGLE_WEB_APP_URL_HERE') {
      fetch(googleAppScriptURL, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify(dataPayload),
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' }
      }).then(function() {
        console.log("Data saved.");
      }).catch(function(error) { console.error("Error:", error); });
    }
  };

  window.ivsDownload = function() {
    const items = [
      { id: 'score-ea', title: 'Emotional Voice Awareness (EA)', desc: 'Awareness of emotional modulation in one’s voice', color: '#0055ff' },
      { id: 'score-pa', title: 'Physical Voice Awareness (PA)', desc: 'Awareness of acoustic and physiological properties of the voice', color: '#0099ff' },
      { id: 'score-vc', title: 'Voice-related Concern (VC)', desc: 'Tendency to experience worry or emotional reactions in response to vocal discomfort or throat sensations', color: '#00ccff' },
      { id: 'score-va', title: 'Voice-related Attention (VA)', desc: 'Capacity to monitor voice-related cues such as posture, breathing, and vocal signals during communication', color: '#00ffcc' }
    ];

    const scale = 2;
    const width = 700;
    const height = 620;
    const padX = 40;
    const barWidth = width - padX * 2;

    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = width * scale;
    canvas.height = height * scale;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.scale(scale, scale);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#222222';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0055ff';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 8, height);

    function wrapText(text, x, y, maxWidth, lineHeight) {
      const words = text.split(' ');
      let line = '';
      for (let n = 0; n < words.length; n++) {
        const testLine = line + words[n] + ' ';
        if (ctx.measureText(testLine).width > maxWidth && n > 0) {
          ctx.fillText(line.trim(), x, y);
          line = words[n] + ' ';
          y += lineHeight;
        } else {
          line = testLine;
        }
      }
      ctx.fillText(line.trim(), x, y);
      return y;
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 26px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Your IVS Profile', padX, 52);

    let y = 92;

    items.forEach(function(item) {
      const scoreText = document.getElementById(item.id).innerText || '0.00 out of 4';
      const scoreVal = parseFloat(scoreText) || 0;
      const fillWidth = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, scoreVal / 4)) * barWidth;

      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.font = 'bold 16px sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText(item.title + ' — Score: ' + scoreText, padX, y);

      ctx.fillStyle = '#cccccc';
      ctx.font = '13px sans-serif';
      y = wrapText(item.desc, padX, y + 18, barWidth, 16);

      const barY = y + 10;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#444444';
      ctx.fillRect(padX, barY, barWidth, 20);

      ctx.fillStyle = item.color;
      ctx.fillRect(padX, barY, fillWidth, 20);

      ctx.fillStyle = '#888888';
      ctx.font = '11px sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      ctx.fillText('0%', padX, barY + 34);
      ctx.textAlign = 'right';
      ctx.fillText('100%', padX + barWidth, barY + 34);
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';

      y = barY + 62;
    });

    ctx.fillStyle = '#888888';
    ctx.font = '11px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('The Interoception in Voice Scale (IVS) — jswlab.co.uk', padX, height - 24);

    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.download = 'IVS_Profile.png';
    link.href = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    link.click();
  };

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', renderCard);
  } else {
    renderCard();
  }
})();
</script>
```
